description: Complete guide for fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B on RTX 4060 using Unsloth QLoRA for DataSoul

overview.goal: Create a DataSoul-specific LoRA adapter that makes Llama 3.1 8B natively understand data quality terminology, respond in DataSoul's format, and produce expert-level preprocessing recommendations without heavy prompt injection.
why_fine_tune: Reduce system prompt length (RAG context + persona = 2000+ tokens per call — fine-tuning bakes some of this in)
Consistent output format (tables, severity indicators, confidence scores) without re-explaining format every time
Makes the model 'feel' custom — it speaks DataSoul natively
Hackathon judges can see: 'We didn't just use an LLM — we trained our own domain expert'
overview.what_we_fine_tune_on: Instruction-tuning pairs from fine_tune_dataset.jsonl — teaches the model DataSoul's analysis style, format, and domain expertise
overview.what_we_dont_fine_tune: Factual knowledge about data science. Llama 3.1 already knows this. We're teaching it HOW to present, not WHAT to know.

setup_commands: pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install unsloth[cu121] datasets transformers trl peft accelerate bitsandbytes

training_script.description: Complete training script for DataSoul LoRA adapter

training_data_format.template:
<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>

You are DataSoul AI, a senior data intelligence analyst.<|eot_id|>
<|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

{instruction}

{input}<|eot_id|>
<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

{output}<|eot_id|>

recommended_dataset_size.how_to_expand: Run DataSoul on real datasets and save the best responses as new training examples. This creates a flywheel — the model improves as you use it.

how_to_use_with_ollama: 1. Export to GGUF format using Unsloth's built-in converter
SYSTEM 'You are DataSoul AI, a senior data intelligence analyst...'
Now 'datasoul' is a custom model name in Ollama that includes your LoRA training!
after_training.integration: The backend will call 'datasoul' model instead of 'llama3.1:8b'. The fine-tuned model responds in DataSoul format natively, requiring less system prompt overhead.

dual_mode_architecture.description: DataSoul uses BOTH fine-tuning and RAG simultaneously for maximum quality
flow: 2. RAG retrieves relevant patterns from knowledge base (dynamic, dataset-specific context)
3. Fine-tuned model receives: short system prompt + RAG context + user query
4. Model generates response in DataSoul format (trained behavior) with dataset-specific details (RAG knowledge)
Fine-tuning = teaches HOW to respond (format, tone, structure, confidence scores)
RAG = teaches WHAT to respond (specific patterns, benchmarks, sector knowledge for THIS dataset)
Together = an expert analyst who speaks your language AND knows your specific data
advantages: Fine-tuning alone: knows the format but lacks specific dataset knowledge
RAG alone: has specific knowledge but outputs in generic LLM format
Both combined: domain expert who speaks DataSoul's language with dataset-specific intelligence
